extraction.Name: Samual Charbonneau
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded March 13, 1918 by C. L. Lice
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to David A. Hancock for $1600 (March 5, 1918), again mortgaged to David A. Hancock for $400 (May 29, 1918); land sold by sheriff foreclosure February 25, 1919; Charbonneau and wife conveyed land by deed to R. J. McAllister for $3500 (March 8, 1919)
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612672 issued; Northwest quarter section 14, township 36, north of range 26; receipt signed by allottee but not dated; sheriff sold land by foreclosure on account of the $400 mortgage
